top: growth in UP's registered GST taxpayers, April 2025 to April 2026, while FY2025-26 GST collection fell 11%.
UP's effective FY2025-26 GST take once IGST settlement is added, ahead of Gujarat's ₹83,096 crore.

sections.h2: Uttar Pradesh overtakes Gujarat once IGST settlement is counted

chart.title: With IGST settlement counted, UP sits above Gujarat in effective GST
chart.sub: Effective GST take per state, FY2025-26, in ₹ crore (SGST plus settled IGST).
chart.source: GSTN, FY2025-26 Collections-Statewise and IGST settlement workbooks.

sections.means: Once IGST settlement is added to SGST, UP's effective total of ₹87,107 crore is ahead of Gujarat's ₹83,096 crore.
sections.todo: Read state GST figures on effective take, meaning SGST plus settled IGST, rather than raw collection.

sections.h2: UP's settled IGST is larger than the SGST it collects directly

chart.title: Most of UP's effective GST take arrives as settled IGST, not its own SGST
chart.source: GSTN, FY2025-26 Collections-Statewise and IGST settlement workbooks.

sections.means: UP's settled IGST of ₹51,422 crore is more than the ₹35,685 crore of SGST it collects directly, the sign of a state that consumes more than it taxes at the point of sale.
sections.todo: Keep IGST settlement and Finance Commission devolution separate when judging state revenue.

sections.h2: UP's GST fell 11% in FY2025-26, then returned to growth by April 2026

chart.title: The full-year fall came late in the year, and April 2026 showed growth again
chart.source: GSTN monthly bulletins for December 2025 and April 2026; Collections-Statewise FY2025-26.

sections.means: UP's GST was flat to growing in December 2025, so the 11.0% full-year fall was driven mostly by the final quarter, January to March 2026.
sections.todo: Watch the construction-sector slowdown that Amar Ujala reported in several UP GST zones, since it is not visible in the state aggregate.
